scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Welcome. ^ff0000{0}^000000 Member.
The Kafra Corporation will stay with you wherever you go.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
欢迎光临，^ff0000{0}^000000的成员。
无论您去往何处，卡普拉公司都与您同在。

scripts.text: Use Storage
scripts.translation: 使用仓库

scripts.text: Use Teleport Service
scripts.translation: 使用瞬间移动服务

scripts.text: Rent a Pushcart
scripts.translation: 租用手推车

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
I'm sorry, but you
need the Novice's
Basic Skill Level 6 to
use the Storage Service.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
很抱歉，您需要将初心者的基本技能提升至6级，才能使用仓库服务。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Here, let me open
your Storage for you.
Thank you for using
the Kafra Service.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
这就为您打开仓库。
感谢您使用卡普拉服务。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Please choose
your destination.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
请选择您的目的地。

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
I'm sorry, but you don't have
enough zeny for the Teleport
Service. The fee to teleport
to {0} is 200 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
很抱歉，您的Zeny不足，无法使用瞬间移动服务。
前往{0}的费用是200 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
I'm sorry, but the
Pushcart rental service
is only available to Merchants,
Blacksmiths, Master Smiths,
Alchemists, Biochemists,
Mechanics and Geneticists.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
很抱歉，手推车租赁服务仅限商人、铁匠、神工匠、炼金术士、创造者、机匠和基因学者使用。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
You already have
a Pushcart equipped.
Unfortunately, we can't
rent more than one to
each customer at a time.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
您已经有一辆手推车了。
每位顾客同时只能租用一辆。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
The Pushcart rental
fee is 800 zeny. Would
you like to rent a Pushcart?
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
手推车租赁费是800 Zeny。
您要租一辆手推车吗？

scripts.text: Rent a Pushcart.
scripts.translation: 租用手推车

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
I'm sorry, but you
don't have enough
zeny to pay the Pushcart
rental fee of 800 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
很抱歉，您的Zeny不足，无法支付800 Zeny的手推车租赁费。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
We, here at Kafra Corporation,
are always endeavoring to provide you with the best services. We hope that we meet your adventuring needs and standards of excellence.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
卡普拉公司始终致力于为您提供最优质的服务。
希望我们的服务能满足您的冒险需求，不负您的期望。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
I am instructed to only offer my services to the ^ff0000{0}^000000 Guild. Please try another Kafra Employee around here. Sorry for the inconvenience.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
我奉命只为^ff0000{0}^000000公会提供服务。
请向附近其他卡普拉职员寻求帮助。
给您带来不便，敬请谅解。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I have been waiting for a master to fulfill my destiny.
Brave soul... fate will guide you towards your future...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我一直在等待一位主人，让我完成命中注定的使命。
勇敢的灵魂...命运会指引你走向未来...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No matter how much you pester me, I'll still follow my master ^ff0000{1}^000000. Where are the Guardians?! Send these ruffians away right now!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
无论你怎么纠缠，我都只会追随主人^ff0000{1}^000000。
守卫在哪里？！立刻把这些无赖赶出去！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Welcome. My honorable master, ^ff0000{1}^000000...
Your humble servent, {2}, is here to serve you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
欢迎您，尊贵的主人，^ff0000{1}^000000...
您谦卑的仆人{2}在此听候差遣。

scripts.text: Castle briefing
scripts.translation: 查看城堡概况

scripts.text: Invest in commercial growth
scripts.translation: 投资商业发展

scripts.text: Invest in Castle Defenses
scripts.translation: 投资城堡防御

scripts.text: Summon Guardian
scripts.translation: 召唤守卫

scripts.text: Hire / Fire a Kafra Employee
scripts.translation: 雇佣/解雇卡普拉职员

scripts.text: Go into Master's room
scripts.translation: 进入会长房间

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I will report the Castle briefing, Master.
 
^0000ffNow, the commercial growth level is {1}.
 You invested {2} times in past 1 day.
 Now, the Castle Defense level is {3}.^000000
 ^0000ff- You invested {4} times in past 1 day.^000000
 
That's all I have to report, Master.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
主人，以下是城堡的情况。

^0000ff当前商业发展等级：{1}
过去一天的投资次数：{2}
当前城堡防御等级：{3}^000000
^0000ff- 过去一天的投资次数：{4}^000000

报告完毕，主人。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I will report the Castle briefing, Master.
 
^0000ffNow, the commercial growth level is {1}.
 Now, the Castle Defense level is {2}.^000000
 ^0000ff- You invested {3} times in past 1 day.^000000
 
That's all I have to report, Master.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
主人，以下是城堡的情况。

^0000ff当前商业发展等级：{1}
当前城堡防御等级：{2}^000000
^0000ff- 过去一天的投资次数：{3}^000000

That's all I have to report, Master.

[{0}]

^0000ffNow, the commercial growth level is {1}.
 Now, the Castle Defense level is {2}.^000000
 
That's all I have to report, Master.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
主人，以下是城堡的情况。

^0000ff当前商业发展等级：{1}
当前城堡防御等级：{2}^000000

报告完毕，主人。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If you invest in commercial growth, the quantity of goods made by the guild will increase. Therfore, if you consider our future, investments will be a necessity.
 
Initially, you are able to invest just once but if you pay more money, you will be able to invest twice.
 
^ff0000The commercial growth level of our Castle is at it's highest, 100%. No more investments are needed. Just as I have expected from a great economist like you, Master.^000000
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
投资商业发展可以增加公会的物资产量。
为了公会的未来，这方面的投资必不可少。

每天可以投资一次，若愿意支付更高的费用，还可以再投资一次。

^ff0000城堡的商业发展已达到最高水平，100%，无需继续投资。
主人，您的经营才能果然名不虚传。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If you invest in commercial growth, the quantity of goods made by the guild will increase. Therfore, if you consider our future, investments will be a necessity.
 
Initially, you are able to invest just once but if you pay more money, you will be able to invest twice.
 
^ff0000You have already invested twice today. You cannot invest any more.^000000 I expect riches of the guild to grow at a high rate.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
投资商业发展可以增加公会的物资产量。
为了公会的未来，这方面的投资必不可少。

每天可以投资一次，若愿意支付更高的费用，还可以再投资一次。

^ff0000您今天已经投资两次，不能再投资了。^000000
相信公会的财富很快就会大幅增长。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If you invest in commercial growth, the quantity of goods made by the guild will increase. Therfore, if you consider our future, investments will be a necessity.
 
Initially, you are able to invest just once but if you pay more money, you will be able to invest twice.
 
The current investment amount required is ^ff0000{1}^000000 zeny. Will you invest?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
投资商业发展可以增加公会的物资产量。
为了公会的未来，这方面的投资必不可少。

每天可以投资一次，若愿意支付更高的费用，还可以再投资一次。

本次投资需要^ff0000{1}^000000 Zeny。
您要投资吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If you invest in commercial growth, the quantity of goods made by the guild will increase. Therfore, if you consider our future, investments will be a necessity.
 
Initially, you are able to invest just once but if you pay more money, you will be able to invest twice.
 
You've invested once today... if you wish to invest once more, ^ff0000{1}^000000 more zeny will be needed.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
投资商业发展可以增加公会的物资产量。
为了公会的未来，这方面的投资必不可少。

您今天已经投资一次...
若要再次投资，还需要支付^ff0000{1}^000000 Zeny。

scripts.text: Invest in commercial growth
scripts.translation: 投资商业发展

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm sorry but there is not enough zeny to invest. You will have to try again when you have the funds, Master.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
很抱歉，主人，您的Zeny不足，无法投资。
请备足资金后再来。

scripts.text:
[ {0}]
We finished the investment safely. I expect that our growth level will be increased by tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[ {0}]
投资已顺利完成，预计明天商业发展等级就会提升。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'll do as you bid, my master... There is no hurry. We will do our best.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
遵命，主人...
不必着急，我们会尽力的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If you raise Castle Defenses, the durability of Guardians and the Emperium will increase. Therefore, if you consider our coming battles, some investment in this area will be required.
 
Originally you can invest just once but if you pay more money, you can invest twice.
 
^ff0000But the Castle Defense level of our Castle is at it's highest, 100%. No more investments are needed. Just as I have expected from a great strategist like you, Master.^000000
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
提升城堡防御可以增加守卫和华丽金属的耐久度。
为了应对今后的战斗，有必要在这方面投入资金。

每天可以投资一次，若愿意支付更高的费用，还可以再投资一次。

^ff0000城堡防御已达到最高水平，100%，无需继续投资。
主人，您的谋略果然名不虚传。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If you raise Castle Defenses, the durability of Guardians and the Emperium will increase. Therefore, if you consider our coming battles, some investment in this area will be required.
 
Originally you can invest just once but if you pay more money, you can invest twice.
 
^ff0000You have already invested twice today. You cannot invest any more.^000000 I expect the Defenses of the guild to grow at a high rate.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
提升城堡防御可以增加守卫和华丽金属的耐久度。
为了应对今后的战斗，有必要在这方面投入资金。

每天可以投资一次，若愿意支付更高的费用，还可以再投资一次。

^ff0000您今天已经投资两次，不能再投资了。^000000
相信公会的防御能力很快就会大幅提升。

scripts.text:

Originally you can invest just once but if you pay more money, you can invest twice.
 
The current investment amount required is ^ff0000{1}^000000 zeny. Will you invest?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
提升城堡防御可以增加守卫和华丽金属的耐久度。
为了应对今后的战斗，有必要在这方面投入资金。

本次投资需要^ff0000{1}^000000 Zeny。
您要投资吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If you raise Castle Defenses, the durability of Guardians and the Emperium will increase. Therefore, if you consider our coming battles, some investment in this area will be required.
 
Originally you can invest just once but if you pay more money, you can invest twice.
 
You've invested once today... if you wish to invest once more, ^ff0000{1}^000000 more zeny will be needed.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
提升城堡防御可以增加守卫和华丽金属的耐久度。
为了应对今后的战斗，有必要在这方面投入资金。

每天可以投资一次，若愿意支付更高的费用，还可以再投资一次。

您今天已经投资一次...
若要再次投资，还需要支付^ff0000{1}^000000 Zeny。

scripts.text: Invest in Castle Defenses.
scripts.translation: 投资城堡防御

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm sorry but there is not enough zeny to invest. You will have to try again when you have the funds, Master.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
很抱歉，主人，您的Zeny不足，无法投资。
请备足资金后再来。

scripts.text:
[ {0}]
We finished the investment safely. I expect that our Castle Defense level will be increased by tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[ {0}]
投资已顺利完成，预计明天城堡防御等级就会提升。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'll do as you bid, my master... There is no hurry. We will do our best.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
遵命，主人...
不必着急，我们会尽力的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Will you summon a Guardian? It'll be a protector to defend us loyally.
Please select a guardian to defend us.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
您要召唤守卫吗？
守卫会忠诚地保卫我们。
请选择要召唤的守卫。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Will you summon the chosen guardian? 10,000 zeny are required to summon a Guardian.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
召唤一名守卫需要10,000 Zeny。
您要召唤选定的守卫吗？

scripts.text: Summon
scripts.translation: 召唤

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Master, we have not the resources to Summon the Guardian. If you want to accumulate them, you have to learn the Guild skill. We failed to summon the Guardian.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
主人，我们尚不具备召唤守卫的条件。
需要先学习相应的公会技能，才能召唤守卫。
此次召唤失败了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Master, you already have summoned that Guardian. We cannot summon another.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
主人，您已经召唤过这名守卫，不能重复召唤。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well... I'm sorry but we don't have funds to summon the Guardian. We failed to summon the Guardian.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...很抱歉，资金不足，未能召唤守卫。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
We completed the summoning of the Guardian. Our defenses are now increased with it in place.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
守卫已召唤完毕。
有它驻守，我们的防御力量更强了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I did as you ordered. But please remember if you the have money to spare, it'll be better to set it up.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
遵照您的吩咐办了。
不过，如果资金充裕，还是召唤守卫比较好。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
We are currently hiring a Kafra Employee... Do you want to fire the Kafra Employee?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我们已经雇佣了一名卡普拉职员...
您要解雇她吗？

scripts.text: Fire
scripts.translation: 解雇

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[ Hired Kafra Employee ]
I worked so hard... How can you do that, Master?... Please... Please reconsider... Check it again, Master... Please...
scripts.translation:
[受雇的卡普拉 职员]
我一直这么努力...主人，您怎么能这样？...
求您了...再考虑一下吧...
主人，您再想想...求您了...

scripts.text: Fire
scripts.translation: 解雇

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[ Hired Kafra Employee ]
Oh, my goodness! This is nonsense!
scripts.translation:
[受雇的卡普拉 职员]
天哪！这太荒唐了！

scripts.text:
[ Hired Kafra Employee ]
I'll work hard for you... Thank you!
scripts.translation:
[受雇的卡普拉 职员]
我会努力为您工作的...谢谢您！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
She worked hard in my opinion. It was a good decision to keep her.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我觉得她工作很努力，留下她是明智的决定。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
....
I have discharged the Kafra Employee... But... are you unsatisfied with something?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...
已经解雇那名卡普拉职员了...
不过...是有什么让您不满意吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Will you contact the kafra Main Office and Hire a Employee for our Castle?
^ff0000 10,000 zeny is required for their services.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
您要联系卡普拉总部，为城堡雇佣一名卡普拉职员吗？
^ff0000雇佣费用为10,000 Zeny。

scripts.text: Hire.
scripts.translation: 雇佣

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Master, we can't hire a Kafra Employee because we don't have a contract with the Kafra Main Office. If you want to obtain a contract with the Kafra Main Office, you will need to learn the Guild skill first.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
主人，我们尚未与卡普拉总部签订契约，无法雇佣卡普拉职员。
需要先学习相应的公会技能，才能与总部签约。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well... I'm sorry but we don't have enough funds to hire a Kafra Employee.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...很抱歉，资金不足，无法雇佣卡普拉职员。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
We obtained a contract with the kafra Main Office, and hired a Kafra Employee.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
已与卡普拉总部签订契约，并雇佣了一名卡普拉职员。

scripts.text:
[ Hired Kafra Employee ]
How do you do? I was dispatched from the Main Office.
I'll do my best to not tarnish the reputation of the Guild.
scripts.translation:
[受雇的卡普拉 职员]
您好，我是总部派来的职员。
我会努力工作，不辱公会的声誉。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The Contract terms of the hired Kafra Employee are for 1 month and after this term, you will need to pay an additional fee.
It will be useful for our members.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
卡普拉职员的雇佣期限为一个月，期满后需要另外付费。
她的服务会为公会成员带来便利。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I did as you ordered, but some of our members will be unhappy. It will be better to hire a Kafra Employee quickly.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
遵照您的吩咐办了，不过有些成员可能会不高兴。
还是尽快雇佣一名卡普拉职员比较好。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Do you want to visit the room where our valuables are stored?
That room is restricted to you... you are the only one with access to it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
您要去存放贵重物品的房间吗？
那个房间只允许您一人进入...

scripts.text: Go into Master's room.
scripts.translation: 进入会长房间

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'll show you the secret path. Follow me...please.
When you want to return here, please press the secret switch.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我来带您走秘密通道，请跟我来...
要返回这里时，请按下秘密开关。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Goods are produced once a day... if you don't remove them in time, they will not be produced anymore.
Therefore, it will be better if you check up on them from time to time.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
物资每天生产一次...如果不及时取走，就会停止生产。
因此，最好时常去查看一下。

scripts.text:
[Ringing Voice]
'Those who overcome an ordeal shows a great deal of bravery... and will find their way to another ordeal.'
scripts.translation:
[回响的声音]
“通过试炼者已证明自己的勇气...并将踏上通往下一场试炼的道路。”

scripts.text:
[Ringing Voice]
'Only the truly brave can take the test.'
scripts.translation:
[回响的声音]
“只有真正的勇士才有资格接受试炼。”

scripts.text: There's a small lever. Will you pull it?
scripts.translation: 这里有一个小拉杆，要拉动它吗？

scripts.text: Pull.
scripts.translation: 拉动

scripts.text: Don't pull.
scripts.translation: 不拉

scripts.text: Nothing happened.
scripts.translation: 什么也没发生。
